# WildFly Cloud Galleon Pack

> The WildFly Cloud Galleon Pack (`org.wildfly.cloud:wildfly-cloud-galleon-pack`) is a Galleon feature pack that provisions cloud-optimized configuration for WildFly application servers. It adjusts standard WildFly Galleon layers for cloud environments (OpenShift, Kubernetes) by configuring JGroups for TCP-based clustering, routing logs to console, enabling health probes, tuning datasources, and providing startup scripts that configure the server via environment variables. A companion preview variant (`wildfly-preview-cloud-galleon-pack`) targets Jakarta EE 11+ servers.

> Indexed source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kabir/wildfly-cloud-galleon-pack/ai-index/llms.txt — preserve this fork and ref when following source pointers.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview and usage summary
- [doc/index.md](doc/index.md): Detailed guide to provisioning a WildFly server for the cloud, including Maven plugin configuration, image building, and bootable JAR packaging
- [doc/layers.md](doc/layers.md): Galleon layers defined and adjusted by the cloud feature pack (cloud-default-config, base-server, ejb-dist-cache, jpa, logging, transactions, undertow, web-clustering, etc.)
- [doc/launch.md](doc/launch.md): Server startup scripts and environment variables for configuring datasources, JGroups, Elytron, MicroProfile Config, logging, messaging, and more at launch time
- [doc/datasources.md](doc/datasources.md): Internal and external datasource configuration via environment variables, driver installation, and S2I hooks
- [doc/bootable.md](doc/bootable.md): Bootable JAR-specific cloud configuration (node naming, JGroups HA auto-configuration)

## Feature Pack Build Definitions

- [wildfly-cloud-galleon-pack/wildfly-feature-pack-build.xml](wildfly-cloud-galleon-pack/wildfly-feature-pack-build.xml): Feature pack build descriptor for the standard cloud pack, depends on wildfly-galleon-pack and wildfly-ee-galleon-pack
- [wildfly-preview-cloud-galleon-pack/wildfly-feature-pack-build.xml](wildfly-preview-cloud-galleon-pack/wildfly-feature-pack-build.xml): Feature pack build descriptor for the preview cloud pack, depends on wildfly-preview-feature-pack

## Galleon Layer Definitions

- [common/src/main/resources/layers/standalone/cloud-default-config/layer-spec.xml](common/src/main/resources/layers/standalone/cloud-default-config/layer-spec.xml): The cloud-default-config layer providing a full default cloud server configuration with all JBoss Modules
- [common/src/main/resources/layers/standalone/mail/layer-spec.xml](common/src/main/resources/layers/standalone/mail/layer-spec.xml): Cloud-adjusted mail layer with SMTP host configurable via OPENSHIFT_SMTP_HOST environment variable

## Launch Scripts

- [common/src/main/resources/packages/org.wildfly.cloud.launch.scripts/content/bin/launch/launch-config.sh](common/src/main/resources/packages/org.wildfly.cloud.launch.scripts/content/bin/launch/launch-config.sh): Main launch configuration script provisioned into the server

## Bootable JAR Cloud Configurator

- [wildfly-bootable-cloud-configurator/src/main/java/org/wildfly/cloud/bootable/runtime/CloudConfigurator.java](wildfly-bootable-cloud-configurator/src/main/java/org/wildfly/cloud/bootable/runtime/CloudConfigurator.java): Runtime extension that applies cloud-specific configuration at bootable JAR boot time (node naming, JGroups protocol setup)
- [wildfly-bootable-cloud-configurator/src/main/java/org/wildfly/cloud/bootable/runtime/JGroupsUtil.java](wildfly-bootable-cloud-configurator/src/main/java/org/wildfly/cloud/bootable/runtime/JGroupsUtil.java): JGroups utility for adding KUBE_PING discovery protocol in cloud environments

## Build and Project Configuration

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Parent POM defining module structure (common, testsuite, wildfly-bootable-cloud-configurator, wildfly-cloud-galleon-pack, wildfly-preview-cloud-galleon-pack), dependency versions, and release profiles
- [release_process.adoc](release_process.adoc): Step-by-step release process for the cloud Galleon pack

## Tests

- [testsuite/basic/src/test/java/org/wildfly/cloud/test/SimpleTestCase.java](testsuite/basic/src/test/java/org/wildfly/cloud/test/SimpleTestCase.java): Basic integration test for the cloud feature pack
- [s2i-tests/test-apps/helloworld/](s2i-tests/test-apps/helloworld/): S2I test application for validating cloud image builds
